THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE NOTICES
============================

TubePort itself is licensed under the MIT License. The public bootstrap ZIP
does not redistribute yt-dlp, Deno, or FFmpeg executables. Setup-Tools.ps1
retrieves pinned, unmodified artifacts directly from each upstream release and
verifies their SHA-256 digests before placing them in the local tools folder.

yt-dlp 2026.08.19
-----------------

Project: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp
Source: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/tree/2026.08.19
Binary: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/download/2026.08.19/yt-dlp.exe

The yt-dlp project source is made available under the Unlicense. Upstream
states that its PyInstaller-bundled Windows executable contains components
under additional licenses, including GPL-3.0-or-later. See:

  licenses/LICENSE-yt-dlp-2026.08.19.txt
  licenses/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES-yt-dlp-2026.08.19.txt
